snippet.title: THE BOX - Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
A Catholic horror video game? Yes. It’s possible. We’ve made one, and it’s the first game by Cibeles Games.

THE BOX is a point-and-click horror game in which you play as a priest who must cast a demon out of a girl.

Along the way, you will learn prayers used against demons and discover a few elements of the history of the Catholic Church.

We are not a Catholic game studio; rather, we decided that our first game would be one. It seemed like an interesting challenge, since although there are horror games that use Catholic imagery, we do not know of any built around the internal coherence of Catholic theology. For this reason, when developing the script we consulted two priests who guided us to ensure that theological coherence. Finally, Fr. D. Jesús de la Cruz, parish priest of Iglesia de Santa Mónica, who was enthusiastic about the project, agreed to participate as the protagonist of the Easter egg contained in THE BOX.

Suitable for Catholic horror fans and for horror fans in general aged twelve and up.

THE BOX is now available for free at:
https://cibeles-games.itch.io/the-box

Voice actor: Pablo Manzano.
